_readme: Public-safe one-line delights about the estate, shown one per day on /private/apps/ (picked at build time by the dailyPick filter in .eleventy.js; the daily 13:00 UTC deploy rotates it). No real personal data, balances, records or credentials.
lines: Eleven apps, three clouds, one desktop in Toronto.
Every app in this catalogue was built this autumn.
AWS, Azure and Google Cloud all hold a piece of the estate.
Two apps share one desktop: Hello World and Hello World Atlas.
Cloudflare R2 keeps the media for two apps.
Six apps answer only on the tailnet.
One board, seven rooms: Atlas is the front hall.
